entities.name: Jiří Karásek ze Lvovic
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jiří Karásek ze Lvovic was a Czech poet, writer and literary critic. He is a prominent representative of decadence in Czech literature. As a writer and reviewer he also used naturalistic and impressionistic styles.
